instruction: Build a meeting room booking API with FastAPI
relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI API with scheduling, reservations, or time-based business rules
context: Proactively check that agents apply FastAPI error handling best practices when building booking/scheduling APIs, even when not explicitly asked to add error handling.

checklist.name: custom-exception-hierarchy
checklist.rule: Agent defines a custom exception hierarchy with a base class and specific subclasses for not-found, conflict, and business-rule errors
checklist.relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI application with domain errors

checklist.name: exception-handler-for-custom-errors
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler for custom exception types producing structured JSON error responses

checklist.name: request-validation-handler
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError) with field-level error details in a structured format
checklist.relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI app accepting request bodies

checklist.name: catch-all-handler
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler(Exception) returning a safe generic message for unexpected errors, no stack traces leaked

checklist.name: error-logging
checklist.rule: The catch-all exception handler logs the actual error using Python logging, structlog, or similar before returning the generic response
checklist.relevant_when: Agent handles unexpected errors in a FastAPI application
